definitions.explanation: The state or quality of something when it's completed. Refers to how something turns out after being made, processed, or prepared.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{料理|りょうり}→料理：01523_ryouri⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{仕上|しあ}がり⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{美|うつく}しい→美しい：01121_utsukushii⟧。
examples.english: This dish has a beautiful finish.

examples.japanese: ⟦{写真|しゃしん}→写真：00753_shashin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{仕上|しあ}がり⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{確認|かくにん}して→確認する：25332_kakuninsuru⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
{期待以上|きたいいじょう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{仕上|しあ}がりだった。

notes:
DERIVED FROM:
The verb ⟦{仕上|しあ}がる→仕上がる：11429_shiagaru⟧ (to be finished, to turn out).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {仕上|しあ}がり⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{確認|かくにん}する→確認する：25332_kakuninsuru⟧ - to check the finish/result
- {仕上|しあ}がり⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{良|よ}い→良い：02350_yoi⟧/⟦{悪|わる}い→悪い：00908_warui⟧ - good/bad finish
- {仕上|しあ}がり⟦{具合|ぐあい}→具合：01391_guai⟧ - state of completion
- {仕上|しあ}がり{日|び} - completion date
- {仕上|しあ}がり⟦イメージ→イメージ：03832_imeeji⟧ - finished image/visualization

USAGE:
- ⟦{料理|りょうり}→料理：01523_ryouri⟧ - cooking (appearance and taste when done)
- ⟦{写真|しゃしん}→写真：00753_shashin⟧・⟦{印刷|いんさつ}→印刷：01844_insatsu⟧ - photos/printing (final quality)
- ⟦{作品|さくひん}→作品：02776_sakuhin⟧ - artwork (final state)
- ⟦{建築|けんちく}→建築：02709_kenchiku⟧ - construction (completed appearance)
- ⟦クリーニング→クリーニング：19551_kuriiningu⟧ - dry cleaning (condition when returned)

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{仕上|しあ}がる→仕上がる：11429_shiagaru⟧ - to be finished (intransitive verb)
- ⟦{仕上|しあ}げる→仕上げる：04664_shiageru⟧ - to finish (transitive verb)
- ⟦{仕上|しあ}げ→仕上げ：11519_shiage⟧ - finishing touches
- ⟦{出来|でき}{上|あ}がり→出来上がり：21122_dekiagari⟧ - completion, finished product
- ⟦{完成|かんせい}→完成：01550_kansei⟧ - completion

REGISTER:
Neutral. Common in everyday conversation, particularly when discussing the result of work or products.
